# BLISS Lab, Yonsei University

> BLISS Lab (BioLogical Interfaces and Sensor Systems) is a research group in the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Yonsei University, Seoul, Korea, led by Jungmok Seo (서정목), Associate Professor · Principal Investigator. The lab develops soft bioelectronic materials, bio-interfaces, implantable sensors, stretchable circuits and IC packaging for devices that work reliably in contact with the body.

- Principal investigator: Jungmok Seo (서정목), ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8898-044X, Google Scholar https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=kl7IdKgAAAAJ
- Publications listed on the site: 102 (numbered #1–#102, newest first)
- Current members listed: 20; alumni listed: 16

## Research themes

## Notes
